how_to: Translate each value of `items` to Thai following references/translation-rules.md. Write done_080.json with the SAME keys: {"items": {key: thai}}. List values stay lists.

items.lang|morerelics|tooltip.relics.thermosei: Explosions do not harm the user and instead grant a stack of Overload for %1$s seconds, with a maximum of 4 stacks.

When activated, it releases a stream of heat in a %1$s block radius, dealing %2$s damage. Stacks of Overload are consumed to amplify the fire's power and range.
While cyberpsychosis is active: The fire triggers as if the user has 2 Overload stacks when they have less and the Overload stacks are not consumed.
This relics gains 5 experience every time you use Thermal Discharge.
This relics gains 20 experience every time explosion damage is blocked.

Killing an enemy has a %1$s% chance to trigger cyberpsychosis for %2$s seconds.
The chance and duration stacks with other Cyberware with this ability.
Cyberpsychosis: Significantly improves Cyberware abilities but erodes sanity, making the familiar foreign.
A high-tech joint implant that absorbs impact and reduces damage, providing extra protection against physical stress.

Reduces damage based on the amount taken, ranging from a maximum of %2$s% to a minimum of %1$s% reduction. The maximum reduction is achieved when the damage taken is equal to users max health or more.
While Cyberpsychosis is active: Damage reduction is always at maximum.
If multiple copies are equipped, damage reduction cannot exceed 50%.
This relics gains 3 experience every time you get hit.

Killing an enemy has a %1$s% chance to trigger Cyberpsychosis for %2$s seconds.
The chance and duration stacks with other Cyberware with this ability.
Cyberpsychosis: Significantly improves Cyberware abilities but erodes sanity, making the familiar foreign.
items.lang|morerelics|tooltip.relics.whims_of_: A cursed die that draws strength from its wielder's despair and suffering, promising salvation while demanding agony in return.
Whenever the user is hit, rolls a 20-sided die. Each number above 1 increases damage reduction by %1$s%. A 20 cancels all damage, a 1 doubles it.
This relics gains 2 experience every time you roll the dice.
items.lang|morerelics|tooltip.relics.depleted_: Once able to regenerate threads that could alter reality, this spool has lost its power. Now silent and empty, it stands as a relic of forgotten potential.
The spool's powers can be restored by holding the required items while wearing it, reawakening its ability to regenerate reality-altering threads.
items.lang|morerelics|tooltip.morerelics.deple: The spool's regenerative abilities are restored!
items.lang|morerelics|tooltip.relics.weavers_s: Restored to its former power, the spool now regenerates silk that can subtly alter reality, weaving outcomes according to the weaver’s design.

Each strike against an enemy weaves silk back into your spool, building up to a maximum of 10 silk stored.
Additionally, gain silk passively every %1$s seconds when you have less than 3 silk.
Consumes 6 silk to heal for %1$s and grants absorption for a short duration, shielding you from further harm.
Consumes 3 silk to propel you in the direction you're facing with a force of %1$s and grants a speed boost for %2$s seconds afterwards.
Consumes 7 silk to unleash a blast that deals %1$s damage and severely slows enemies for %2$s seconds within a 4-block radius around you.
items.lang|morerelics|tooltip.relics.whims_of_: This relics gains 3 experience every time you gain silk.
A symbiotic worm that manipulates its host's emotions, helping them adapt and thrive in shifting conditions.

The worm changes its mood every 10 minutes, providing different benefits:
Furious: Increases damage by %1$sX and attacks burn enemies.
Joyful: Increases speed and luck by %1$sX.
Gloomy: Reduces damage taken by %2$s% and increases resistance to knockback.

The worm can switch to a new mood.
Tranquil: Provides all the advantages of the worm's other moods.
This relic gains 20 experience each time the mood changes.
items.lang|morerelics|tooltip.relics.convergin: A rather heavy orb made from an unknown material which permanently compresses under pressure.
Every time the user is hit the orb undergoes permanent compression, decreasing its size and dramatically increasing its density.
items.lang|morerelics|tooltip.morerelics.conve: Task: Get hit the Warden's sonic boom.
The orb exceeded critical density, collapsing in on itself to form a miniature black hole.
items.lang|morerelics|tooltip.relics.wonder_of: The orb has collapsed in on itself, becoming a miniature black hole. It now absorbs any harm aimed at its user, redirecting it toward those who oppose them.

%1$s% of the incoming damage is also dealt to the attacker.

Reflected damage cannot exceed the user's current health.

When attacked, the attacker suffers a random negative potion effect.
Cooldown: %1$s seconds.

Upon activation, the user unleashes a blast that knocks back and stuns nearby enemies.
For the next %1$s seconds, the user enters a state of nullification, gaining complete invincibility and doubling the effects of Entropy and Flow of Calamity. This ability has a cooldown of %2$s seconds.
This relic gains 5 experience each time you reflect damage.
items.lang|morerelics|tooltip.relics.gravitum_: A glove which is made from a unique cloth-like material which anchors itself to its current position, making it very hard to move. When it collides with an object it transfers a massive amount of energy, creating a powerful impact even at low speed.
Multiplies attack damage by %1$sX but reduces attack speed by 66%.

Attacks over 20 damage (before armor) have a %1$s% chance to trigger a heavy strike, dealing 2X damage and inflicting Dazed for %2$s seconds.
Dazed enemies have a chance to miss their attacks.
This relic gains 2 experience each time the user attacks.
items.lang|morerelics|tooltip.relics.vertebrax: A high-tech spine implant designed to boost immunity by continuously injecting poison into the body... It was quickly banned and pulled from the market due to obvious reasons.

Harmful potion effects have their duration reduced by %1$s%. These effects have a %2$s% chance to be filtered, decreasing their level or reducing duration by an additional 20% if the level is already at its minimum. Filtration also synthesizes the opposite beneficial effect for half the original duration if it exists.
While cyberpsychosis is active: Synthesized effects are more powerful and the reduction is amplified by 50%.
Completely converts Poison into Regeneration for its full duration.

Killing an enemy has a %1$s% chance to trigger Cyberpsychosis for %2$s seconds.
The chance and duration stacks with other Cyberware with this ability.
Cyberpsychosis: Significantly improves Cyberware abilities but erodes sanity, making the familiar foreign.
This relic slowly gains experience while it is worn.
items.lang|morerelics|tooltip.relics.epoch_app: An ancient apple believed to be from the earliest generations of its kind. Its regenerative abilities allow it to recover from severe damage which is how it has survived through the ages.
The apple recovers to its full form after %1$s minutes of being eaten.
The apple ripens into greater quality after %1$s minutes of being in its full form.
This relic gains 120 experience every time it is eaten.
items.lang|morerelics|tooltip.relics.gravitum_: A boot that uses a Gravitum engine to reduce the effects of gravity. It was commonly used by astronauts for training before the severe health risks of Gravitum were discovered.
Reduces your gravity by %1$s%. Fall damage and safe fall distance are adjusted accordingly.
Jumping after crouching for one second launches you upwards with a force of %1$s. You take reduced fall damage from this jump.
This relic gains 1 experience each time the user jumps.
items.lang|mortal_cultivation|mortal_cultivati: Waste but not discouraged, mortal body hides edge, defying fate reveals the brilliant immortal path
The Foundation Establishment stage is the first step in cultivation, with some spiritual energy and the ability to perform a double jump and immune to fall damage within 8 blocks.
A cultivator who has condensed spiritual power into a Golden Core and gained finer control over qi.
A cultivator whose Golden Core has transformed into a newly formed Nascent Soul.
A cultivator whose Nascent Soul has broken through and formed a divine body.
A cultivator who refines the power of the void to temper their body and spirit.
A cultivator who has united body and soul after mastering Void Refinement.
A peak mortal cultivator standing one step away from immortal ascension.
A cultivator facing heavenly tribulation in final preparation for ascension.
A true immortal who has survived heavenly tribulation and successfully ascended.
A supreme cultivator who commands the laws of heaven and has become one with the Heavenly Dao.
The ultimate realm of one who has surpassed the Heavenly Dao and shattered its laws.

Talisman Apprentices are cultivators who have chosen to specialize in the art of talisman-making during the Foundation Establishment stage. They can perform air jumps and are immune to fall damage within 8 blocks.
An advanced cultivator who has risen from Talisman Apprentice and mastered the creation and use of talismans.
A high-level cultivator versed in the profound arts of talisman craft.
An evolution of the Sigil Master who has brought the talisman arts to their highest mortal realm.
An evolution of the Sigil Saint who has entered the immortal realm of talisman cultivation.

The Demonic Foundation Stage is the entry level of demonic cultivation where practitioners have chosen the demonic path and established the foundation for demonic cultivation, with the ability to perform a double jump and immune to fall damage within 8 blocks.
